evidence_scope: full 2000-session train_explore shared-cohort diagnostic candidate-recall probe; target-cluster and outer-fold views are diagnostic and are not private validation

prior_stage.c400_interpretation: evaluator-side import implementation failure after target-free gates; neither Go nor algorithm No-Go; never rerun and never used as an E0 candidate baseline

historical_p7_boundary.model_and_route: same frozen BGE-small model/index, Dense-120, sparse Broad-120 stable-union Strict-80, diagnostic-only
historical_p7_boundary.cohort: separate product-disjoint 200-session P7 selection cohort; this preregistration does not open or rerun that protected corpus
why_current_probe_is_not_a_p7_rerun: full sealed variable-length C200 prefix instead of raw Broad-120 union Strict-80
Dense depth frozen once at 400 instead of 120
all ten sealed causal turns instead of only P7 control-reached eligible turns
candidate-recall-only evidence with unchanged served Top10

frozen_embedding_assets.reuse_only: never rebuild, overwrite, modify, copy, quantize, convert, download, or train the model/index in this experiment

model.all_required_files: exact eleven-entry sizes and hashes from configs/p7_bge_small_en_v1_5.json

license_identity.source: Git LF blob, not autocrlf working-tree bytes

model_spec.identity_authority: Git LF blob bytes plus parsed canonical JSON; autocrlf working-tree bytes are explicitly non-authoritative

index.path_policy: model and index roots must be ordinary local directories, not symlinks, junctions, reparse points, or Hugging Face cache aliases

historical_build.interpretation: historical sunk build cost only; rebuilding is forbidden

encoder.query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

encoder_and_search_identity.query: single ASCII-space join of the frozen Agent _query_terms at the pre-P11 boundary after current visible state/override processing; empty query gives an empty dense route
encoder_and_search_identity.search: exact full float32 matrix dot product
encoder_and_search_identity.dense_order: score descending then parent_asin ascending; stable over the parent_asin-ascending index

unique_mechanism.name: FROZEN_BGE_DENSE400_STABLE_TAIL_AFTER_FULL_VARIABLE_C200
unique_mechanism.dense_route: one frozen Dense-400 route from the current causal visible-state query
unique_mechanism.candidate_surface: complete sealed ordered variable-length C200 followed by Dense-400 identifiers not already in C200, preserving dense order, capped at 400 without padding
unique_mechanism.retention: the complete C200 is an exact ordered prefix; old candidate loss and candidate-level hit-to-miss are structurally zero
unique_mechanism.served_top10: unchanged production C200 first 10 after control P11; dense candidates are diagnostic only
unchanged: catalog embedding matrix, BGE model, tokenizer, pooling, query instruction and search tie order
production sparse retrieval, fusion, coverage, P11, small-ranker, question order, session state and Top10
catalog, visible context, C200 trace, proxy, labels, folds and evaluator semantics
unique_mechanism.runtime: target-blind, causal, local-only, deterministic, diagnostic-only and default off

formal_protocol.entrypoint: direct-script and python -m synthetic checks must both succeed before commit; formal direct entrypoint explicitly bootstraps repository root before evaluator-side imports
formal_protocol.preflight: may read only Git, environment, catalog, tracked sources, P7 model/index/license identities, sealed C200 aggregate/context/traces and historical tracked documentation; it must not stat/open/hash proxy, labels, P7 selection, calibration, selection, confirmation, public or Amazon heldout

receipt.creation: prepared real parent, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL, canonical pending LF and fsync; any existing state forbids rerun
receipt.failure: catch BaseException and durably replace only through the same descriptor with INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED

formal_protocol.worker_phase: two simultaneous fresh offline CPU workers receive only catalog, visible context, one sealed C200 reference, frozen BGE assets and frozen semantic index; each recomputes the frozen control path solely to derive causal current-state query terms and computes Dense-400 only at the pre-P11 boundary; every recomputed control turn must exactly match the sealed C200 reference before any outcome is opened
formal_protocol.pre_target_gates: both workers close Agent/SQLite/model/index, publish O_EXCL traces, pass full variable-C200 prefix, unchanged Top10, dense route, schema, catalog, exact-repeat, source, Git and resource gates
formal_protocol.join_phase: only then open proxy once with same-handle double-hash/fstat for target/eligibility and read numeric outer_fold then family_index; compute aggregate membership only
formal_protocol.forbidden: do not invoke the C200 or C400 experiment runners, rebuild either cache, or reinterpret either receipt; the worker's target-free control recomputation is only an identity guard needed to derive causal query terms and is not a new C200/C400 experiment; no index rebuild, fit, threshold selection, full Agent evaluator, protected split, network, GPU, output identifiers, or per-session vectors

exact_repeat: two fresh worker trace bytes, hashes, record counts, ordered candidate arrays, recall aggregates and inflation aggregates are identical; timings and RSS are excluded

decision.recall_go: all integrity/resource gates pass and C200-plus-Dense400 recall is strictly above sealed C200 with at least one incremental target cluster
decision.recall_no_go: all integrity/resource gates pass and C200-plus-Dense400 recall equals sealed C200
decision.embedding_adapter_e1_gate: strict positive target-uniform recall, at least two outer folds, at least one non-clothing incremental taxonomy, no candidate loss, exact repeat and all resource gates pass
decision.next_stage: record the unique result and continue to deterministic GLoSS G0; only a passing E1 gate can later authorize the embedding adapter
